title: Proverbs Bible Quiz - Chapter 19
description: Ten questions on Proverbs 19: integrity, pity on the poor, and Yahweh's counsel that prevails.

questions.text: According to the first verse, who is better than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:1 says better is the poor who walks in his integrity than he who is perverse in his lips and is a fool.

answers.text: The poor who walks in his integrity

questions.text: What does wealth add, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:4 says wealth adds many friends, but the poor is separated from his friend.

questions.text: According to this chapter, what is a man's glory?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:11 says the discretion of a man makes him slow to anger, and it is his glory to overlook an offense.

questions.text: What is the king's wrath compared to in this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:12 says the king's wrath is like the roaring of a lion, but his favor is like dew on the grass.

questions.text: House and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but where is a prudent wife from?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:14 says house and riches are an inheritance from fathers, but a prudent wife is from Yahweh.

questions.text: What will the idle soul suffer, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:15 says slothfulness casts into a deep sleep, and the idle soul shall suffer hunger.

questions.text: To whom does he who has pity on the poor lend?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:17 says he who has pity on the poor lends to Yahweh, and he will reward him.

questions.text: There are many plans in a man's heart, but what will prevail?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:21 says there are many plans in a man's heart, but Yahweh's counsel will prevail.

questions.text: What does the sluggard do with his hand, according to this chapter?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:24 says the sluggard buries his hand in the dish and will not so much as bring it to his mouth again.

answers.text: He stretches it out to the poor
He buries it in the dish

questions.text: What does this chapter call a son who robs his father and drives away his mother?
questions.explanation: Proverbs 19:26 says he who robs his father and drives away his mother is a son who causes shame and brings reproach.

answers.text: A son who causes shame and brings reproach
A son who shall not inherit
